full_judgment: Salma Masud Chowdhury, J: This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party Nos. 1 and 2(Gha) to show cause as to why the order no. 54 dated 14.10.2002 passed by the Assistant Judge, Nawabganj Court, Dhaka in Title suit No. 8 of 2000 allowing the application under order 26 Rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure filed by the plaintiff for local investigation of the suit land should not be set aside and/or pass such other orders or further order or orders as to this court may seem fit and proper.
